# OSPFv3 DBD (`ospfv3_dbd`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: variable length

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ospfv3`](ospfv3.md) | `type` | 2 (0x02) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reserved1` | `uint(8)` | `0` |   |   |
| `options` | `flags(24)` | `0x13` |   | OSPFv3 options (V6, E, N, R, DC, AF bits). |
| `interface_mtu` | `uint(16)` | `1500` |   | Largest IP datagram the interface can send without fragmentation. |
| `reserved2` | `uint(8)` | `0` |   |   |
| `flags` | `flags(8)` | `0x7` |   | Database Description flags (I = init, M = more, MS = master). |
| `dd_sequence` | `uint(32)` | `1` |   | Database Description sequence number. |
| `lsa_headers` | `list<struct>` — rest of the PDU |   |   | LSA headers (20 octets each; checksums and lengths are Manual). |

### `options`

| Bit | Mask | Name |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 (0x000001) | `v6` |
| 1 | 2 (0x000002) | `e` |
| 3 | 8 (0x000008) | `n` |
| 4 | 16 (0x000010) | `r` |
| 5 | 32 (0x000020) | `dc` |
| 8 | 256 (0x000100) | `af` |

### `flags`

| Bit | Mask | Name |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 4 (0x04) | `init` |
| 1 | 2 (0x02) | `more` |
| 0 | 1 (0x01) | `master` |
